case_name: City of Davao v. Court of Appeals and GSIS
ordinance_no: Davao City Real Property Tax Assessment on GSIS
ordinance_title: DAVAO CITY MUNICIPAL REAL PROPERTY TAX ASSESSMENT ON GSIS PROPERTIES
challenged_clause_text: Assessment Mandate: Notices of assessment and warrants of levy imposing municipal real property taxes upon GSIS properties located in Matina and Ulas, Davao City, for outstanding municipal tax liabilities.
statute_premise_text: Section 193 & Section 234. Withdrawal of Tax Exemption Privileges. Unless otherwise provided in this Code, tax exemptions or the incentive privileges granted to or presently enjoyed by all persons, whether natural or juridical, including government-owned or controlled corporations, are hereby withdrawn.
legal_doctrine_rationale: Sections 193 and 234 of RA 7160 expressly withdrew prior real property tax exemptions of government-owned or controlled corporations, making Davao City's municipal tax assessment a lawful exercise of delegated authority.
